articles.title: UK's financial watchdog cracks down on Premier League crypto partnerships
articles.snippet: The FCA said unauthorized firms could be breaching rules on financial promotions through high-profile sponsorships deals.

articles.title: Crypto PACs pour $3M into Maryland races as California voters head to polls
articles.snippet: An affiliate of a political action committee backed by crypto companies ramped up spending on ads in California ahead of Tuesday’s primaries, but still has millions of dollars at stake in Maryland later this month.

articles.title: Anthropic Expands Access to Claude Mythos After AI Giant Files for IPO
articles.snippet: Just a day after the nearly $1 trillion AI giant revealed IPO plans, Anthropic is letting more firms access its powerful Claude Mythos model.
